title: Then and now — the forecourt, 1872 and today
learning_goal: See the 1872 forecourt against today's; know the station still runs about a train an hour to Dover.

narration.script: Drag the seam. On the left, an engraving from 1872 — the year itself — the hotel and forecourt as Fogg saw them. On the right, the cross today. Six platforms behind it, and still about a train an hour to Dover. You can still buy a ticket for Dover at Fogg's station. The through route to Paris, though, now leaves from St Pancras. The hotel is a hotel still, under a newer name.
